decisions.reason: The UV spot varnishing system is a distant flagship whose market value is still uncertain two years after its German premiere, and as a distributed partner product it costs little to keep, so the option stays open while demand for digital enhancement develops.
The sheet preparation module complements the established finishing systems at low holding cost and has shown no negative signal, so keeping it preserves upside cheaply.
The B2 multifinisher is a core-adjacent flagship aligned with the firm's automation direction, which justifies continued commitment rather than abandonment.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the core booklet-making business with low holding costs, and its prospects are not yet resolved, so keeping it is the sensible option.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation running inline, a positive signal of its value at little cost to keep.
